why: Source: kg needed, wild cost, tiered aquaculture cost applying the volume threshold, difference with other costs ignored (4 steps); question: kg needed, local cost, tiered imported cost with the same threshold, difference with the same irrelevant-cost trap (4 steps).

Source: total cost from fixed plus volume times variable, Group B share as cumulative difference (trap), multiply (3 steps); question: the same total-cost build, cumulative difference and multiply (3 steps).

Source: read bars 1 and 2 off gridlines of an unlabelled cumulative chart, take the difference (avoiding the bar-height trap), multiply by the market total (3 steps); question: the same gridline reads, difference and multiply (3 steps).
Source: two margins from printed profit and revenue, then their difference in points (3 steps); question: the same two margins and difference (3 steps).

Source: chain four funnel percentages on calls, saving per property from value times reduction times tax rate, halve it, multiply (4 steps); question: the same funnel chain, per-shipment duty saving, halving and multiplication (4 steps).

Source: read margin indices off gridlines, combine with revenue to test four statements (half-year profit, ratio of index changes, annual profit ratio, overall change) (about 5 steps); question: the same gridline reads and the same four statement tests (about 5 steps).

Source: total profit decline rate, apply to international, add domestic, sales from total over margin, new margin (5 steps); question: decline rate, apply to resorts, add city hotels, sales from total over margin, new margin (5 steps).

Source: total profit decline rate, apply to international, add domestic, sales from total over margin, new margin (5 steps); question: decline rate, apply to online, add shops, sales from total over margin, new margin (5 steps).
Source: respondents times first-pie share, then times second-pie share avoiding the skip-the-first-pie trap (2 steps); question: the same two chained shares (2 steps).

Source: pick max minus min as the volatility measure, compute four ranges (two obvious), order them (about 4 steps); question: the same measure choice, four ranges with two obvious, ordering (about 4 steps).
